title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery submits for review and approval a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Caritas Norwood Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms to be purchased under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioner James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-29)
